Sort the remaining critical bridges by their priority score from highest to lowest, returning a list of two element lists containing the identifier and the priority score.

title: Bird Banding Recoveries
spec: Provide a function `analyze(recoveries)` to evaluate bird migration tracking data. Each recovery contains a species name, origin latitude and longitude, and recovery latitude and longitude. Calculate the approximate travel distance for each bird using the absolute differences in coordinates. Filter the dataset to include only long distance migrations, defined as a distance greater than ten units. Next, group the data by species to find the maximum travel distance recorded for each species. Sort the resulting species alphabetically and return a list of two element tuples containing the species name and its longest migration distance.

title: Residential Solar Potential
spec: Create a function `evaluate(roofs)` to estimate neighborhood solar power generation. Each roof provides an address, usable square footage, tilt factor, orientation direction, and a shade reduction percentage. Isolate roofs that have a south facing orientation. Calculate the energy yield for each remaining roof by multiplying the usable area, tilt factor, and shade reduction percentage. Filter out any roofs where the calculated yield is less than five hundred units. Sort the final viable roofs in ascending order of their energy yield. Output a list of addresses for the recommended installations.

title: Vintage Computing Hardware
spec: Write a function `inventory(items)` to appraise a collection of old computer equipment. Each item details a brand, model, release year, a boolean indicating working condition, and an estimated monetary value. Exclude any items that are not in working condition or were released after nineteen ninety. Group the qualifying items by their brand and compute the total estimated value for each brand. Sort the brands alphabetically. Return a list of two element lists, where each inner list contains the brand name and the total monetary value of its vintage working hardware.

title: Municipal Recycling Contamination
spec: Develop a function `audit(routes)` to identify problematic recycling collection paths. Each route includes a route identifier, total collected weight, weight of contaminated material, and a list of observed incident types. Compute the contamination percentage by dividing the contaminated weight by the total weight. Flag routes where the contamination exceeds fifteen percent or where the incident list includes hazardous waste. Keep only the flagged routes, and map them to their route identifier and contamination percentage. Sort the output list in descending order of contamination percentage.

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Network
spec: Construct a function `locate(stations, latitude, longitude)` to find nearby fast chargers. Each station provides a name, its location coordinates, a list of charger speeds in kilowatts, and a boolean indicating if it is out of service. Ignore any stations that are currently out of service. Calculate the straight line coordinate distance from the user location to each station. Find the maximum charger speed available at each location, and filter out stations where the fastest charger is less than fifty kilowatts. Sort the available fast stations by distance from closest to furthest, returning a list of station names.

title: Digital Library Audiobook Checkouts
spec: Implement a function `summarize(checkouts)` to analyze listening habits. Each checkout record contains a user identifier, book title, genre, minutes listened, and a completion boolean. Discard any records where the user listened for fewer than fifteen minutes or did not complete the book. Group the remaining valid checkouts by genre, summing the total minutes listened for each category. Convert the total minutes into hours for each genre. Sort the genres from highest total listening hours to lowest. Return a list of tuples containing the genre and the total hours.

title: Public Park Amenities Assessment
spec: Create a function `assess(parks)` to evaluate local recreational spaces. Every park provides a name, acreage, a list of available facilities, and a maintenance score out of one hundred. Count the number of distinct facilities each park offers. Filter the dataset to include only parks that have more than five acres of land and a maintenance score of at least seventy five. Sort these high quality parks in descending order based on their facility count. Return a list of two element lists containing the park name and the number of facilities.

title: Regional Water Quality Tests
spec: Write a function `inspect(samples)` to process environmental data. Each sample includes a location identifier, a numeric acidity level, a list of contaminant concentrations, and a collection date. Determine if a sample is hazardous, which occurs if the acidity level is outside the safe range of six point five to eight point five, or if any contaminant concentration exceeds fifty units. Keep only the hazardous samples. Map each hazardous sample to a two element tuple containing the location identifier and the collection date. Sort the resulting tuples chronologically by the collection date string.

title: Street Sweeper Fleet Operations
spec: Develop a function `sweep(records)` to measure fleet efficiency. A sweep record contains a vehicle identifier, driver name, miles covered, gallons of water consumed, and the shift type. Calculate the efficiency of each route by dividing the miles covered by the gallons of water consumed. Filter the records to include only those from the night shift. Sum the total miles covered and average the efficiency for each vehicle identifier across their night shifts. Sort the vehicles from most to least total miles covered, returning a list of vehicle identifiers.

title: Voting Machine Turnout
spec: Construct a function `tabulate(precincts)` to audit local election data. A precinct record includes a precinct identifier, number of registered voters, machine vote counts, and provisional ballot counts. Add the machine vote counts and provisional ballots together to get the total votes cast. Calculate the voter turnout percentage by dividing total votes by registered voters. Exclude any precincts where the turnout is zero or exceeds one hundred percent. Sort the valid precincts in descending order of turnout percentage, outputting a list of precinct identifiers.

title: Astronomical Observatory Schedule
spec: Implement a function `schedule(requests, equipment, minutes)` to manage telescope time. Each request has an astronomer name, target celestial object, priority level, required instrument, and duration in minutes. Check if the required instrument is present in the provided available equipment list. Verify that the requested duration is less than or equal to the total available night minutes. Filter out requests that fail either condition. Sort the approved requests by priority level from highest to lowest. Output a list of astronomer names who will receive observation time.

title: University Textbook Exchange
spec: Write a function `exchange(listings)` to process student book sales. A listing provides a course code, textbook title, physical condition, asking price, and seller email. Accept only listings where the physical condition is excellent or new. Further filter the listings to remove any with an asking price above sixty dollars. Group the affordable, high quality listings by course code, finding the lowest asking price available for each course. Sort the course codes alphabetically and return a list of lists containing the course code and the lowest price.

title: Agricultural Soil Samples
spec: Provide a function `analyze(fields)` to generate fertilizer recommendations. Each field contains a farm name, crop type, a list of acidity readings, and soil texture. Compute the average acidity for each field from its list of readings. Identify fields that require treatment by checking if the average acidity falls below six point zero. Group these acidic fields by the farm name, counting how many fields on each farm need treatment. Sort the farms in descending order based on the count of fields needing treatment. Return a list of farm names.

title: Internet Outage Reports
spec: Create a function `outages(reports)` to prioritize network repairs. An outage report consists of a provider name, geographical region, duration in minutes, number of users affected, and a resolution boolean. Discard any reports that have already been resolved. Calculate the total impact of each ongoing outage by multiplying the duration by the number of affected users. Filter out outages where the total impact is less than ten thousand. Sort the severe outages by impact in descending order. Return a list of geographical regions experiencing severe outages.

title: Coral Reef Bleaching Surveys
spec: Develop a function `bleaching(surveys)` to monitor ocean health. A survey contains a reef name, depth in meters, a list of bleaching percentages from different transects, and average water temperature. Calculate the overall bleaching percentage for each reef by averaging the transect values. Categorize a reef as severely bleached if its overall percentage exceeds forty percent. Keep only the severely bleached reefs. Sort them in ascending order of depth so shallow reefs appear first. Output a list of tuples containing the reef name and its overall bleaching percentage.

title: Bicycle Sharing Trips
spec: Construct a function `ridership(trips)` to analyze urban mobility. Each trip provides a starting station, ending station, duration in seconds, and subscriber type. Exclude trips that lasted less than one hundred twenty seconds, as they are likely false starts. Keep only trips made by annual subscribers. Count the number of valid trips originating from each starting station. Sort the stations by their trip counts in descending order to identify the busiest hubs. Return a list of two element lists containing the starting station and its trip count.

title: Space Shuttle Launches
spec: Write a function `launches(missions)` to aggregate historical spaceflight data. A mission record contains a mission designation, launch year, payload mass in kilograms, crew size, and a boolean indicating success. Filter the dataset to include only successful missions that carried at least one crew member. Group the successful crewed missions by launch year, summing the total payload mass delivered to orbit for each year. Sort the results chronologically by launch year. Output a list of tuples containing the launch year and the total payload mass.

title: Public Transit Accessibility
spec: Implement a function `transit(neighborhoods)` to assess transportation coverage. A neighborhood record includes a name, population, a list of transit stop names, and the average walking distance to a stop. Count the number of transit stops available in each neighborhood. Filter the neighborhoods to keep those that have at least three transit stops and an average walking distance of less than one mile. Sort these well connected neighborhoods in descending order of population. Return a list of neighborhood names.

title: Board Game Design Contest
spec: Create a function `judge(designs)` to evaluate contest submissions. Each design features a designer name, a theme score, a mechanics score, an originality score, and a rules clarity score, all out of ten. Calculate the total score for each design by adding the four categories together. Eliminate any designs that received a rules clarity score lower than six. Sort the qualifying designs from highest to lowest total score. Return a list of designer names representing the finalists.

title: Community Theater Auditions
spec: Develop a function `cast(actors, range)` to filter acting candidates. An actor record contains a name, vocal range, a list of previous roles, and a boolean for availability during performance dates. Discard any actors who are not available. Check if the actor's vocal range matches the provided required range. Filter for actors who match the vocal range and have at least two previous roles. Sort the final candidates alphabetically by name. Return a list of actor names for the director to consider.

title: Autonomous Delivery Robots
spec: Provide a function `dispatch(robots)` to route available delivery units. A robot record includes an identifier, battery percentage, a list of completed delivery times, and current operational status. Exclude any robots whose operational status is not idle. Count the number of completed deliveries for each robot. Filter the idle robots to keep only those with a battery percentage above thirty percent. Sort the ready robots in ascending order of completed deliveries so that less utilized units are dispatched first. Output a list of robot identifiers.
